item.title: Trial Opens for Lindsay Clancy, Mother Accused in Deaths of Her 3 Children
item.description: A Massachusetts woman’s trial has begun, with her lawyers expected to argue that postpartum issues drove her to kill her three children.

item.title: GOP's years-long focus on progressive dark money may now backfire on Trump.
item.description: The Trump-linked group Freedom 250 celebrated Independence Day with tens of millions in undisclosed funds.

item.title: Firefighters battle massive blazes in France and Spain ahead of expected heat wave.
item.description: Hundreds of thousands remained evacuated as large wildfires burned across France and Spain, with crews racing to gain ground.
